messages:
alex: Heads-up: seeing steady memory growth in the console dashboard after doing quick time-range toggles. Sparkline widgets seem to accumulate. Noticed on canary.

maya: Repro steps?

alex: Steps: open team dashboard -> click last 30m, 1h, 1d, 7d quickly. After ~15 toggles JS heap up ~120MB -> 420MB. RSS grows too.

alex: Minimal logs:
```
perf: rss 210MB -> 360MB after 15 toggles
window.performance.memory: { usedJSHeapSize: 125000000 }
```

jordan: Is this only on canary or in prod as well?

alex: Only on canary `canary-2` so far, not on prod canary-1. Canary tag in header.

sam: I think I saw something similar last month — likely an effect cleanup issue in the sparkline component.

maya: Can you paste the sparkline useEffect?

sam: snippet from Sparkline.jsx:
```
useEffect(() => {
  const id = dataStream.subscribe(onPoint)
  // no cleanup
}, [dataStream])
```

lucy: Yep that will leak. Need `return () => dataStream.unsubscribe(id)` and also ensure `onPoint` stable via useCallback.

alex: Also see telemetry hook subscribing to route+mouse events in `telemetry/eventBus.ts` — I found listeners accumulate when switching widgets.

alex: Heap diff (retained types):
- Sparkline (x45)
- SubscriptionCallback (x90)
- EventEmitter (x12)

perf-bot: :warning: perf-alert: memory-growth-suspected on canary-2 at 11:43 UTC

jordan: Can someone add a small repro sandbox? I can then run heap snapshots in devtools quickly.

sam: I'll try a quick PR. Plan: add unmount cleanup, memoize handlers, add unit test that mounts/unmounts 100x and asserts no leak. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1234|#1234>

lucy: Also audit any global `on()` usage in telemetry/index.ts — I remember we didn't remove listener on unmount for rapid prototypes.

maya: After fix, let's run canary rollout to 10% with perf tracing flagged. If there is still regression we'll revert.

alex: Assigned to @sam. I'll attach heap snapshots and a short repro script in the PR.

sam: Starting work now, aim for hotfix today. Thanks all.

lucy: :thumbsup:
